title: Akbar Battle Of Haldighati
definition: A decisive military engagement fought on June 18, 1576, between the Mughal Empire, led by Raja Man Singh I, and the forces of Mewar, commanded by Maharana Pratap, in the narrow mountain pass of Haldighati, Rajasthan.
importanceInUpsc: Tests the understanding of Mughal expansionist policies, Rajput-Mughal relations, and the historiography of regional resistance against imperial hegemony.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Akbar Battle Of Haldighati.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
